thesis: The speaker illustrates the immense power of compound interest by recounting the story of Peter Minuit purchasing Manhattan for 60 guilders (approximately $24) and calculating that, if invested at a 7% annual return, the amount would have grown to approximately $17 trillion by 2026. The speaker concludes that the Native Americans received a good deal but failed to maximize the value because they lacked a competent trust officer to manage the investment over such a long period.
